_doc: LANCE-19 batch 4: Vedette (Shiaic3D Vedariant hull + Tank-Schrek turret), tracked.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 4, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in vedette_veh.json). Moving parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (vedette_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_*`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above the per-part budget (no Blender collapse on shell soup). TRACKED, low-poly 6 mm kit (hull and the Tank-Schrek turret, two STLs); the turret `Vedette Turret` turns about its ring (pivot moved to the turret body centre). Belts `track_l`/`track_r` (faces within 120 mm of the closed belt path; the kit's tracks are plain slabs, so the belt is the slab with a tread strip of 2 x 220 mm); seven wheels a side are own geometry on the slab's outer face. One long gun that is part of the turret (no `gun` part, as in the original). The planar dissolve is 1 degree because the kit is already low-poly.
